usedFor: Shopify raises product events, and Screenshot API receives a page address to capture through “Capture Website Screenshot”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Capture Website Screenshot” in Screenshot API
bestTemplate.why: A new product page can be captured as an image for records or review.

watchOut: “Capture Website Screenshot” in Screenshot API needs a page URL, so pass the product's page address.
